Kutuphane -> Calgi sayfasi -> Kurs -> Ders. Her calgi KENDI sayfasi.
DURUSTLUK KURALLARI (mekanik olarak test edilir, tools/validate_library.py):
1. status=coming_soon olan calgida KURS OLAMAZ (sahte kurs listelenmez).
2. Her kursun en az 1 dersi olmak zorunda (bos kurs listelenmez).
3. Ders, ruleset'te BULUNMAYAN teknige atif yapamaz.
4. Her calgida honesty bloku ZORUNLU (neler olculur / neler OLCULMEZ).

disciplines.blurb: Put your phone where it can see you sitting with your guitar. We check your sitting posture against how real teachers sit. This build hears nothing: there is no microphone input, so every judgement comes from the camera.

measured: Trunk alignment while sitting — checked against 7 independent guitar teachers who agree to within 2.24 degrees of each other (config/references/guitar-posture-setup.v1.json, ATTESTED)
notMeasured: Anything you play. The chord engine is real and measured — it covers the 8 open chords this course teaches (E A D G C Am Em Dm) and refuses a chord outside them by name ('not one of the chords this lesson covers') instead of reporting the nearest one that is. But it has only ever run on recordings. There is no microphone input in this build, so none of it runs in your room.
Arm and hand position while holding the guitar — teachers disagree about this by style (11-18 degrees apart), we show it but do not grade it (M-O-46)

Finger placement or fretting technique — the camera does not resolve fingers well enough to grade them. At the distance that keeps your hips in frame, a fingertip is a few pixels wide, so there is nothing stable to measure.

Strum timing — NOT measured. We can hear individual note attacks, but a strum is one gesture producing six near-simultaneous ones, and the step that maps those onto a chord does not exist. Until 2026-08-04 this line claimed the timing was measured and merely ungraded; that was wrong, and the config carried a matching dead gate.
Full note-by-note transcription — we recognise the chord class, not every note played

Chords beyond those 8 — we do not name them. Until 2026-08-04 we did something worse than not naming them: a played Bb was reported as 'Dm' in 28 of 29 windows, confidently, because the engine was only allowed to consider the 8 chords of the drill. It now weighs all 24 chords and refuses when the winner is not one this lesson teaches.
honesty._audioClaimsMoved: 2026-08-07: bu disiplinin measured listesindeki SES iddiası notMeasured'a taşındı ve blurb'ü düzeltildi. Sebep ölçüldü: Info.plist'te NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, AndroidManifest'te RECORD_AUDIO YOK ve kabukta tek bir ses yakalama çağrısı yok — motor gerçek ve fixture üzerinde ölçülü, ama kullanıcının ODASINDA hiç koşmuyor. "Ölçüyoruz" listesi ürünün en güçlü iddia yüzeyidir; oradaki yanlış bir satır en pahalı olanıdır. Tek bir olgu KAYBEDİLMEDİ, yalnız MEKÂNI doğru yazıldı (kayıtta ölçüldü ≠ odanda ölçülüyor). tools/validate_surface_honesty.py kural C bunu artık mekanik olarak kolluyor ve izin beyan edilince kendini emekliye ayırır.

lessons.displayName: Holding the guitar — measured, never graded
lessons.demoOnlyReason: You see your own elbow and forearm angles, live, next to the range the teachers we recorded occupy. What you do not get is a mark, because there is nothing honest to mark you against.

promotionPath.blockedBy: The elbows and forearms of the teachers in our reference spread across 39 to 105 degrees. A tolerance built from that spread would call almost nothing an error, and a tighter one would call ordinary style an error.
promotionPath.unblockedBy: A measurement that separates style from mistake on this joint chain — e.g. a harvest where takes are labelled by teaching intent, so agreement can be computed within intent rather than across it.
promotionPath.ifItStaysBlocked: The lesson stays exactly as it is: measurement shown, no mark. That is a legitimate permanent resting state, not a failure — but we do not declare it permanent, because the camera CAN see these joints. What is missing is consensus, not sight.

lessons._why_not_permanent: M-F-245 sozlugu: `permanent` KAMERANIN GOREMEDIGI kalite boyutu icindir. Kol acilarini kamera GORUYOR ve olcuyoruz — eksik olan uzlasi. Bunu `permanent` ilan etmek, olcum bosluguyla kategori farkini karistirmak olurdu (kamera-korlugu != uzlasi-yoklugu).
lessons._why_not_locked: Kilitli ders hicbir yuzey tasimaz; oysa bu olcum GERCEKTEN yapiliyor ve durustluk kutusu kullaniciya zaten 'gosteriyoruz ama puanlamiyoruz' diyor. Kilitlemek, yaptigimiz olcumu saklamak olurdu.
lessons._supersedes: 2026-08-04: bu ders KILITLIYDI. lockedReason'i zaten dogru seyi soyluyordu ('11-18 derece ayri tutuyorlar, bu stil, puanlanacak dogru yok') ama KILIT yanlis araci: olcum gercekten yapiliyor ve durustluk kutusu kullaniciya 'gosteriyoruz, puanlamiyoruz' diyor. demoOnly/structural-circular tam bu durum.
lessons._priorLockedReason: We can see your arms but we deliberately do not grade them. The three teachers we measured hold the guitar 11-18 degrees apart from each other — that is style, not error, so there is no honest 'correct' to score you against. This lesson opens only if a measurement is found that separates style from mistake.

lessons.lockedReason: Nothing below your hips is measured. Our posture reference is built from upper-body landmarks only, because guitar teaching footage is filmed waist-up — knees and ankles are usually not in frame at all. Without leg landmarks we cannot tell a footstool from a crossed leg.

Chord recognition has only been proven on synthetic audio (8/8 chords, zero false judgements) — it has never been tested on a real guitar recording. Synthetic tones have no body resonance, no string buzz and no overlapping decay, which are exactly the things that break a chord classifier. We won't grade you against a measurement we haven't confirmed on a real instrument.

comingSoonInThisDiscipline: Strum timing as a graded skill — blocked twice over: the strum-to-chord alignment step is not built, and no teacher data exists on how far off the beat counts as a mistake

Arm/hand posture as a graded skill — the seven teachers we measured hold the guitar 39 to 105 degrees apart at the elbows and forearms. That is style and camera angle, not error; this may never become gradeable.

Named posture coaching (the 'you are slouching' cue) — the threshold is derived from the reference (14 degrees, the spread inside which two teachers count as sitting the same way), but the question of whether a measurement may be spoken as a correction is open, and it is not ours to close: it needs a movement-science review we have not commissioned.

measured: Trunk alignment, before you sing and while you sing — checked against 6 independent voice teachers who agree to within 1.35 degrees of each other (config/references/voice-posture-setup.v1.json, ATTESTED)
notMeasured: Whether the room is quiet enough and your voice is loud enough to judge at all. The gate that refuses rather than guessing is built and exercised on recordings, but there is no microphone input in this build, so it never runs on your room. The setup check says the same thing in its own words, and shows no progress bar for a capture that does not happen.

Pitch accuracy and steadiness while singing — the engine works and is measured, but it has only been confirmed on real CELLO audio, never on a real singing voice. Locked until it is (see the Sustained note lesson).
Vibrato — measured, never judged. We have no teacher data on what rate is 'right', and inventing one would be a guess dressed as a measurement.
Arm, shoulder and elbow position — the six teachers disagree with each other by 43 to 88 degrees on these. That is style and framing, not error, so we show them and never grade them.

Anything below your hips, and your head and jaw — voice teaching footage is filmed waist-up, so knees are usually not in frame, and our posture reference carries no head landmark. This is why we cannot name the posture mistakes teachers actually talk about (locked knees, lifted chin).
Breath support, larynx position, tongue root — not visible to a camera at all. They are in our error library and deliberately out of product scope.

measured: Trunk alignment while you sit — checked against 3 independent piano teachers who agree to within 1.09 degrees of each other, the tightest agreement of any instrument we have measured (config/references/piano-posture-setup.v1.json, ATTESTED)
notMeasured: Note timing in your room. The timing measurement is real and was made on a recording (AF-008-five-note-timing); it has never run live, because there is no microphone input in this build. The line below explains why it would still not be graded even if it did.

Note timing as a GRADE. We measure it for real (AF-008-five-note-timing), and that measurement is exactly what rules out grading it: the engine reads a perfectly-on-beat note as 8.3 ms early, and that bias falls unevenly — the same 40 ms error reads as 49 ms when you rush and 31 ms when you drag. Grading on that would punish rushing harder than dragging for no musical reason.

Wrists, fingers and hand shape — we have no hand or finger landmarks at all, only body joints. Every hand-related mistake in our error library is blocked on that missing tool, not on a missing threshold.

Shoulder tension — the mistake teachers name most often for piano (5 independent channels). We can see shoulders but the three teachers' shoulder angles differ by 24 vs 5 degrees between left and right, and 'shoulders rising toward the ears' is a height, not the angle we hold. Naming it would be guessing.
Elbow distance from the body — measured, but the three teachers' elbow angles spread across 20 to 77 degrees. That is noise, not a threshold.
Bench height, pedalling, evenness of touch, note reading — either blocked on the same missing tools or outside what a camera can see.
honesty._audioClaimsMoved: 2026-08-07: bu disiplinin measured listesindeki SES iddiası notMeasured'a taşındı ve blurb'ü düzeltildi. Sebep ölçüldü: Info.plist'te NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, AndroidManifest'te RECORD_AUDIO YOK ve kabukta tek bir ses yakalama çağrısı yok — motor gerçek ve fixture üzerinde ölçülü, ama kullanıcının ODASINDA hiç koşmuyor. "Ölçüyoruz" listesi ürünün en güçlü iddia yüzeyidir; oradaki yanlış bir satır en pahalı olanıdır. Tek bir olgu KAYBEDİLMEDİ, yalnız MEKÂNI doğru yazıldı (kayıtta ölçüldü ≠ odanda ölçülüyor). tools/validate_surface_honesty.py kural C bunu artık mekanik olarak kolluyor ve izin beyan edilince kendini emekliye ayırır.

courses.goal: Set up your space and learn to sit at the keyboard the way experienced teachers sit.

lessons._why_unlocked: OLCUM IDDIASI YOK — saf yonerge dersi (J-038 / gitar deseni).

lessons.displayName: How you sit at the keyboard
lessons._why_unlocked: trunk_tilt referansi ATTESTED (3 bagimsiz egitmen, dispersiyon medyani 1.09 derece — uc calginin en DAR anlasmasi). Skorlama bari artefaktan turetildi (8.0 derece).
lessons._why_thin_base: DURUST SINIR: 3 take, minTakes esiginin TAM USTUNDE (gitar 7, san 6). Kanit kalinligi 3 take'in 2'sinde 1.00. Referans gecerli ama havuzun en incesi — yeni piyano kaynagi geldiginde ilk yeniden-olculecek olan bu.
lessons._why_no_errorFocus: M-O-64: piyanonun kamerayla gorulebilir postur kodlarindan HICBIRI trunk_tilt'e karsilik gelmiyor. P-POST-SHOULDER-TENSION omuz YUKSEKLIGINI anlatir (elimizdeki omuz metrigi bir ACI, ustelik coached_only ve sol/sag 5 kat asimetrik); P-ELBOW-ANGLE dirsek istatistigi tasimiyor (20-77 derece). Kodun kosulu bu turda trunk_tilt'ten SOKULDU — yanlis metrige bagliydi.
lessons._why_observationCue: M-F-232 (M-F-125 zeyli, 2026-08-04): bu ders bir GÖZLEM İŞARETİ gösterir, hata kodu DEĞİL. Ayrım iddia sınıfında: 'ölçtüğümüz N eğitmenin hiçbiri bu kadar eğilmiyor, sen şu andasın' bir ÖLÇÜM BEYANIDIR ve kanıtı elimizde (ATTESTED referans + artefakttan türetilmiş 14,0° eşik + _derivedFrom damgası). 'Şöyle otur / duruşun yanlış' ise bir ÖĞÜTTÜR ve movement-science doğrulaması ister — o şerit expertPending'de KAPALI kalıyor. İşaret aralığın İÇİNDEYKEN SUSAR ve referansı KURAN eğitmen karelerinin hiçbirinde ateşlemez (ölçüldü: gitar 0/939 · şan 0/729 · piyano 0/407).

lessons._why_unlocked: OLCULEN ICERIK, ICAT YOK: 3 piano teachers hold-penceresinde trunk_tilt medyanlari 1.9° ile 2.8° arasinda (0.9° genislik). Ders bu banti gosterir — yeni bir metrik ya da yeni bir esik GEREKTIRMEZ, ayni ATTESTED referansin zaten tasidigi dagilimi okur. Icerik referansin kendi kaydindan turetildi (Choreia uydurmama emsali). This is also the thinnest evidence we have: 3 teachers is the floor our agreement gate accepts, and a narrow band from few sources is partly a small-sample effect, not proof that piano posture varies less.
lessons._why_it_matters: Urunun en kolay yanlis anlasilan yani: 'dogru durus' bir NOKTA degil BANT. Kullanici 3° egikse ve bunu hata sanip duzeltmeye calisirsa, olctugumuz egitmenlerin yarisindan uzaklasmis olur.
lessons._why_observationCue: Ayni gozlem isareti (M-F-232 uclu standardi): bant ICINDE SUSAR, disinda gorunur ve cumle kaynagini tasir.

lessons._why_unlocked: Ikinci olcum DEGIL, AYNI olcunun ikinci ani — gitar ve sanda zaten olan dersin piyano karsiligi. trunk_tilt kapisi PLAY fazinda da kosuyor ve uctan-uca senaryoda GERCEKTEN kosuldu (2026-08-04: POSTURE_CHECK 80 kare + PLAY 79 kare, trunk_tilt PASS 80/80). Yeni esik YOK: ayni turetilmis merdiven (bar 8,0°).
lessons._why_it_was_missing: Gitar ve sanda vardi, piyanoda yoktu — ayni kanit uc calgida da gecerliyken ders yolu ikisinde kurulmustu. Eksiklik olcumde degil ICERIKTEYDI.
lessons._why_no_errorFocus: M-O-64 aynen: piyanonun hicbir postur kodu trunk_tilt'e karsilik gelmiyor.

lessons.lockedReason: We can hear every note you play and time it against the beat — you will see those numbers. What we cannot do is turn them into a mark. No piano teacher data exists on how far off the beat counts as a mistake, and our own timing engine reads a perfect note as 8.3 ms early with a bias that falls harder on rushing than on dragging. A grade built on that would be arithmetic, not teaching.
lessons._why_locked_detail: M-O-65: PLAY fazinin note_timing_ms quality kapisi INDIRILDI. Iki kusur ust usteydi — (1) kapi URETILMEYEN bir metrige bakiyordu (MetronomeAligner koduna hicbir fixture bagli degildi), (2) bar (50 ms) UYDURMAYDI. Simdi metrik gercekten olculuyor (AF-008) ama bar hala yok: postur referansi EKLEM olcer, zamanlama olcmez.

lessons.demoOnlyReason: You see your own elbow and forearm angles, live, next to the range the teachers we recorded occupy. What you do not get is a mark, because there is nothing honest to mark you against.

promotionPath.blockedBy: The elbows and forearms of the teachers in our reference spread across 20 to 77 degrees. A tolerance built from that spread would call almost nothing an error, and a tighter one would call ordinary style an error.
promotionPath.unblockedBy: A measurement that separates style from mistake on this joint chain — e.g. a harvest where takes are labelled by teaching intent, so agreement can be computed within intent rather than across it.
promotionPath.ifItStaysBlocked: The lesson stays exactly as it is: measurement shown, no mark. That is a legitimate permanent resting state, not a failure — but we do not declare it permanent, because the camera CAN see these joints. What is missing is consensus, not sight.

lessons._why_not_permanent: M-F-245 sozlugu: `permanent` KAMERANIN GOREMEDIGI kalite boyutu icindir. Kol acilarini kamera GORUYOR ve olcuyoruz — eksik olan uzlasi. Bunu `permanent` ilan etmek, olcum bosluguyla kategori farkini karistirmak olurdu (kamera-korlugu != uzlasi-yoklugu).
lessons._why_not_locked: Kilitli ders hicbir yuzey tasimaz; oysa bu olcum GERCEKTEN yapiliyor ve durustluk kutusu kullaniciya zaten 'gosteriyoruz ama puanlamiyoruz' diyor. Kilitlemek, yaptigimiz olcumu saklamak olurdu.

comingSoonInThisDiscipline: Note timing as a graded skill — measured today, blocked on two things: teacher data about what counts as off-beat, and a fix for the engine's asymmetric bias
Everything involving hands and fingers (wrist collapse, flat fingers, hand shape) — blocked on hand landmarks, a missing measurement tool rather than a missing threshold
Shoulder tension, the mistake piano teachers name most — needs a shoulder-height metric we do not have, plus its own reference statistic
disciplines._priorReasonSuperseded: 2026-07-30: onceki gerekce 'take'ler ANLASMIYOR' idi ve M-O-56 teshisiyle GECERSIZ kaldi — anlasmayan, urunun SKORLAMADIGI kol zinciriydi. Kayit birakiliyor cunku o gerekce bir sure kullaniciya gosterildi.
disciplines._openedAt: 2026-08-04: coming_soon -> live. Uctan-uca DOGRULANDI (POSTURE_CHECK->PLAY, trunk_tilt 80/80 PASS); drill yolu kuruldu (titular drill kilitli, gerekce olculdu); hata koclugu OLCULDU ve NEGATIF cikti + yanlis-eslesmis bir kod (P-POST-SHOULDER-TENSION) bu turda sokuldu. Disiplin ACILIYOR ama vitrini POSTURDUR — blurb ve honesty kutusu bunu soyluyor.
